editor_note: None of the six rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The negations in the compose and decompose notes (entries 26 and 33, "**non** modifica") are kept exactly, as are the "usually" and "often" qualifiers in entries 17 and 18 ("di solito", "spesso"). Entry 46 renders "do not need to be defined until just before executing" faithfully as "non è necessario specificare fino a poco prima dell'esecuzione". A native editor would still touch two phrasings. Entry 14 writes "il [X-gate]" and "del [U3-gate]", but a native writer would say "gate X" and "gate U3", or at least "l'X-gate", since X is read "ics". Entry 17's "trattate come fisse" is a literal calque of "treated as fixed"; "immutabili" is the idiomatic term here.

examples.source: For example, the [X-gate](...) is defined as a specific case of the [U3-gate](...)
examples.translation: Ad esempio, il [X-gate](...) è definito come un caso particolare del [U3-gate](...)
examples.suggested: Ad esempio, il [gate X](...) è definito come un caso particolare del [gate U3](...)
examples.why: The article "il" before "X-gate" is wrong because X is pronounced "ics" (it should be "l'X-gate"). Italian technical prose normally uses the "gate X" / "gate U3" word order anyway.

examples.source: Instructions are treated as fixed, and their methods will usually return new instructions
examples.translation: Le istruzioni sono trattate come fisse, e i loro metodi di solito restituiscono nuove istruzioni
examples.suggested: Le istruzioni sono considerate immutabili e i loro metodi di solito restituiscono nuove istruzioni
examples.why: "Trattate come fisse" is a literal calque. "Immutabili" is the natural Italian programming term for this idea, and the English-style comma before "e" should go.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful. Entry 29 renders "does not match both" as "il numero di parametri o il numero di qubit non corrisponde (basta che uno solo dei due differisca)", which keeps the error condition correct, and entry 51 renders "quality-of-life improvements" naturally as "accorgimenti pensati per la comodità d'uso".

Both rewritten entries (7 and 9) match the English and read naturally. "flatter access patterns" becomes "pattern di accesso più diretti", "two qubit links" becomes "collegamenti tra coppie di qubit", and the caveat that `BackendV2.coupling_map` leaves some target detail out is kept.

Rewritten entries 3, 4 and 9 keep the source's meaning, including the "e forse non ne esistono" hedge, the claim that "alcuni ritenevano" quantum computing would be impossible, and "codice di Shor a 9 qubit". They also read naturally.

All seven rewritten entries keep the meaning of the English and read naturally. Examples: "ci servono molti meno bit" in [18], the unary-encoding "esplosione esponenziale" caveat in [21], "collegando in cascata due half adder" in [74]/[77], and "divisione per tentativi" with O(n^2 2^{n/2}) in [108].

All 12 rewritten entries are faithful to the English. Caveats and conditions are kept, including the underestimate-vs-overestimate trade-off for dt in [151], the non-unitarity caveat in [163] and the 'only advantageous above a certain dimension' point in [45], and the informal 'tu' register holds (considera, nota, puoi). A native editor would still fix some calqued phrasing. In [89], 'sarà un grande contributo al tempo di calcolo' copies 'large contributor', and 'i limiti di memoria possono limitare' repeats itself. In [202], 'sufficiente da richiedere' is not idiomatic Italian, and in [151] 'permettere contributi ... di corrompere' is missing the preposition 'a'.

examples.source: will be a large contributor to total computing time required ... But memory constraints can limit the use of traditional Krylov methods.
examples.translation: sarà un grande contributo al tempo di calcolo totale richiesto ... Ma i limiti di memoria possono limitare l'uso dei metodi di Krylov tradizionali.
examples.suggested: contribuirà in larga misura al tempo di calcolo totale ... Ma i vincoli di memoria possono restringere l'uso dei metodi di Krylov tradizionali.
examples.why: 'Essere un grande contributo al tempo' copies the English wording, and 'limiti ... limitare' repeats the same root. The meaning is intact.

examples.source: the depth is still sufficient to require state-of-the-art error mitigation
examples.translation: la profondità è ancora sufficiente da richiedere la mitigazione degli errori all'avanguardia
examples.suggested: la profondità è ancora tale da richiedere tecniche di mitigazione degli errori all'avanguardia
examples.why: 'Sufficiente da' is not idiomatic Italian. The natural forms are 'tale da' or 'sufficiente a'.

examples.source: overestimating can allow contributions from high-energy states to corrupt even the optimal state
examples.translation: una sovrastima può permettere contributi degli stati ad alta energia di corrompere persino lo stato ottimale
examples.suggested: una sovrastima può permettere ai contributi degli stati ad alta energia di corrompere persino lo stato ottimale
examples.why: 'Permettere' needs 'a' before the person or thing that is allowed to act. Without it the sentence reads as a calque, though the meaning is right.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries (2, 19, 20) keep the English meaning. The caveats "assuming a good initial state and sparsity", "converges with increasing d" and "in general, one could use PauliEvolutionGate" are all there, and nothing was added. The one real flaw is in entry 2: "questo approccio è dimostrato convergere in modo efficiente" copies the English passive-plus-infinitive pattern and is not grammatical Italian. It should be "è dimostrato che questo approccio converge in modo efficiente". Entry 19 has a small word-order calque, "di come i circuiti sono progettati", which reads better as "di come sono progettati i circuiti".

examples.translation: [questo approccio è dimostrato convergere in modo efficiente](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09702)
examples.suggested: [è dimostrato che questo approccio converge in modo efficiente](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09702)
examples.why: "essere dimostrato" followed by a bare infinitive copies the English syntax and is not grammatical Italian. The normal pattern is "è dimostrato che ...".

examples.translation: di come i circuiti sono progettati
examples.suggested: di come sono progettati i circuiti
examples.why: In Italian indirect questions the verb usually comes before the subject. Keeping the English subject-verb order sounds slightly translated.

editor_note: All five rewritten entries are faithful, and they match the rest of the page: entry 62 keeps r=10, 5 Trotter steps per time step and the deepest-circuit caveat ("mantenendo il circuito più profondo ... sostenibile"), and "Step 1-4" in entry 190 matches the "Step 1/2/3/4" headings used elsewhere.

None of the 8 rewritten entries would mislead a learner. The numbers, conditions and caveats all match the English: the exponent -0.3 with A_ref 18/42, 'Le energie a singola particella non vengono riscalate', the 1.963.461 and 4.000 determinant counts, the steep-versus-flattened convergence logic in [133], and '1 MeV' / 'circa 2 MeV' in [167]. A native editor would still smooth a few calques. In [54], 'file portano l'esponente' copies 'carry', and 'il nucleo in fase di calcolo' is clumsy. In [107], 'un filtro ampio' is an unclear rendering of 'a large filter', which means a check that rejects many samples.

examples.why: 'Portare' copies 'carry'. For values stored in a file, Italian technical prose uses 'riportare' or 'contenere'.

examples.line_approx: per il nucleo in fase di calcolo
examples.translation: per il nucleo in fase di calcolo
examples.why: 'In fase di calcolo' is a stiff literal rendering. 'In esame' or 'che si sta calcolando' reads naturally.

examples.line_approx: non che ciascuno sia un filtro ampio
examples.source: not that each one is a large filter
examples.translation: non che ciascuno sia un filtro ampio
examples.suggested: non che ciascuno scarti molti campioni
examples.why: 'Filtro ampio' is unclear: it could be read as a permissive filter, the opposite of the intended meaning. Saying what the check does keeps the point clear.
